title: Umupfunda Wagabuye Amaraso
intro: Iyumvire umwuzure munini uriko uraduga hejuru y’isi, Ubwato bureremba budahinduka, n’umutima umwe usigaye hanze kubera amahitamwo. Uwo muntu yari aboshe n’amaraso n’umuhanuzi ariko akaba atandukanye n’ivyo yemera, yari afise umuhamagaro wa nyuma wo kuza mu bwato uko amazi yariko araduga. Woba ushobora guhishura akaranga kari inyuma y’ukwo kwanka?
clues: Ndi uruvyaro rw’umwe mu bahanuzi bakuru ba Allah, urugo rw’ukwizera nahisemwo kuvamwo.
Nabayeho mu gihe c’Umwuzure Munini, igihe ukutemera kwapfutse igihugu nk’amazi.
Naranse kwinjira mu bwato n’abizera igihe dawe yampamagaye.
Nanje nti nzorondera ubuhungiro ku musozi kugira ngo nkingire amazi.
Nabwiwe ko ata kintu na kimwe coshobora kunkingira itegeko rya Allah kuri uwo musi kiretse imbabazi.
Narashikiwe n’imipfunda ndarohama, dawe barambwira ko ntari uwo mu muryango wiwe w’abagororotsi.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Kugurishwa mu buja mu Misiri amaze guhemukirwa n’abavukanyi .

Gutererwa mu muriro ururumba kubera gumena ibigirwamana .
Kumirwa n'ifi nini inyuma yo guhunga ubutumwa
Gusinzira imyaka amajana mu mwobo kugira ngo uhunga uruhamo .
trial.answer: Kwanka kwinjira mu bwato no kurondera umusozi ngo ube ubuhungiro .

Kuzurwa ari muzima mw'ijuru no gukizwa kubambwa .

outcome.answer: Yarohamye mu Mwuzure kandi ntiyamenyeshwa ko atari uwo mu muryango w’abagororotsi .

arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌۭ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verse: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!" (11:45)
